title: organizations: on an un-walled first boot, seed person references to the first admin land NULL, and only owner_id is handed over
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kgF3mo9f7LXuv5hac

Filing gate: ① (named location; carrier for L1 REWORK R1 6928510218 on PR #34457 / #34425).

**Where:** the un-walled (single-tenant) first boot, from the boot seed load to the first-admin seed-ownership handoff (`packages/plugins/organizations`, with the fixture in `packages/plugins/organizations/src/default-organization-seed-owner.wall.test.ts`, describe block `control: the same seed on an un-walled boot reads as it did before the fix`).

**What happens (measured by the #34425 dev on main 6a7403ba, control leg of that test):** the boot seed loads before the dev admin's `sys_user` row exists. A seed `Field.user` / `Field.lookup('sys_user')` reference that names the first admin therefore lands NULL ("no such sys_user row exists"). Afterwards the first-admin handoff writes `owner_id` only. The stored row reads `{ assignee: null, reviewer: null, owner_id: <admin> }`.

This is the same outcome #34425 fixed on the walled boot, reached through another entry point: of the seed's person columns that name the owner, only `owner_id` gets repaired. PR #34457 fixes the walled path only, and its CONTROL test pins the un-walled reading as it stands on main.

**Done when:** on an un-walled first boot, every seed person reference that names the first admin resolves to that admin. The fix might replay the seed after the first admin exists, or resolve those references at the handoff; that is the builder's choice. The CONTROL test named above is flipped from `assignee: null, reviewer: null` to the admin id, so the pin moves with the fix.

**Business reason:** a new single-tenant install that ships sample records assigned to "the owner" shows them unassigned, except for the record owner.

**Reader who acts:** the objectstack server lane (organizations / seed loader). Triage first-touches the grade.

**Dedupe:** searched open issues for un-walled seed `sys_user` owner NULL: none.
